title: Cinnabun
role: Self-initiated - concept, AI direction, compositing, motion
sub: An experimental campaign for a cinnamon roll, built end to end with AI, motion and sound.

blocks.heading: Project Overview
cols: An experimental campaign to my favorite dessert. As a designer always exploring new tools, I challenged myself to bring the cinnabon to life through AI, storytelling, and motion.
This self-initiated project combines visual research, image generation, scripting, sound design, and compositing - all tied together in one atmospheric loop.

blocks.heading: Prompting & Generating
cols: Prompting is a design process. After collecting references, I iterated on prompts in both Midjourney and ChatGPT to generate images with the right lighting, mood, and sugary detail.
It took a mix of patience and obsession.

blocks.caption: A fluffy cinnamon roll with light golden dough, covered in glossy, semi-liquid white glaze dripping richly down the sides. Floating mid-air against a warm, vintage brown backdrop, with a soft glow and camera flash highlighting its shiny, juicy texture. Shot with a Canon EOS R5, wide angle lens, nighttime lighting, cinematic depth of field, 9:16 aspect ratio.
Isolated floating ball of white cake glaze, glossy and thick with natural drips, soft studio lighting, black background, highly realistic and appetizing
Logotype made of thick white sugar glaze, glossy and dripping like dessert icing. Rounded, hand-piped look with natural drips, Hyper-realistic.

Illustrated guide showing how to make cinnamon rolls. Hand-drawn step-by-step sketches: spreading, rolling, cutting, baking, and glazing. Soft pastel tones, Roman numerals (I-IV), labeled details (A-F), grid paper background. Cozy, vintage feel.

blocks.heading: Cleanup & Prep
cols: Beyond color and lighting tweaks, I used Photoshop for deep retouching, removing, adding, and rearranging elements to fix flawed generations.
When AI struggled with placement or logic, I manually composited objects (like a cinnabon in a hand) to get the scene just right.

blocks.heading: Animation & Compositing
cols: I used Kling AI to animate the stills and brought them into After Effects to add transitions, masks, type, and ambient effects.
Every edit was aimed at creating visual rhythm and mood.

blocks.heading: Voiceover & Sound
cols: The script was co-written with ChatGPT and narrated using Eleven Labs.
I layered it with subtle sound effects and ambient textures to create a warm, focused soundscape that supports the visuals without overpowering them.

blocks.heading: Closing
cols: This project was a personal exploration of how AI tools can intersect with traditional design workflows to create something playful, polished, and a little surreal.

It deepened my understanding of prompt-based image generation, voice synthesis, and motion design. but more importantly, it reminded me how much I enjoy experimenting across mediums. I plan to continue exploring new AI-generation methods and hybrid workflows, combining them with classic design platforms to push both aesthetics and process forward.
